decisions.reason: The black border instruction explicitly applies only to the zebra print; the basket-weave design has its own separately specified fine mustard edge.
The zebra-specific black border instruction does not change the terracotta block-colour pareo, whose black border was already established independently.
The source explicitly assigns the new border treatment to the zebra print and does not modify the mustard block-colour pareo's existing black border.
Adding a black border to the zebra artwork does not alter the production-file, colour-preparation, fabric, or ICC-profile specifications.
